player_intent: A grounded rifle stop blends from its last evaluated pose without continued outgoing gait deformation.
acceptance_rule: Native eligible rifle-to-idle arrivals select one private raw snapshot inside the existing AnimationTree. Outgoing keys stay constant, destination advances, existing transition owns curve and completion, camera root/coverage remain coherent, and interruption restores old selectors. Disabled, pistol, action, traversal and unsafe captures retain fallback. This is a raw graph adapter, not complete original procedural-wrapper parity.

nodes.role: Single animation owner with private constant graph branches

visual_check: Actual main rifle running stop: inspect early/middle/late in rear and side views for stable body/root, continued destination, hands and feet. Verify action/fire interruption does not retain a frozen selector.

system_delta.reason: Keep the original departing raw pose inside the existing graph instead of a second timer or post-IK writer. Guard unsupported cases.

current.system: Live outgoing gait under source transition curve

candidate.system: Private constant outgoing branch with mixer-applied raw observation
